subject: Geography
source_note: TIE (2023), Geography Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the structure of the Earth

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of the origin and the structure of the Earth and Earth systems
competences: (a) Explain the concept and scope of Geography (branches, importance and relationship with other disciplines)
(b) Describe the Earth (origin, shape, size, position and movements of the earth in the solar system, and parallels and meridians)

objectives.text: (a) Explain the concept and scope of Geography (branches, importance and relationship with other disciplines)
objectives.resources: Relevant books, charts, and ICT simulation tools on the concept of Geography
objectives.assessment_criteria: Basic concepts of Geography are clearly explained

objectives.text: (b) Describe the Earth (origin, shape, size, position and movements of the earth in the solar system, and parallels and meridians)
objectives.resources: Relevant books, globe, picture of solar system, relevant ICT simulation tools and models on the planet earth

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of the major features of the Earth surface
competences: (a) Describe major features of the Earth’s surface (continents, oceans, major relief features, large inland water bodies and vegetation zones)

objectives.text: (a) Describe major features of the Earth’s surface (continents, oceans, major relief features, large inland water bodies and vegetation zones)
objectives.resources: Environment, relevant books, relief maps, globe/models, and relevant ICT simulation tools
objectives.assessment_criteria: The major features of the Earth are correctly described
